matter._comment: Optional Matter protocol support for Homebridge. When enabled, accessories can be published via both HomeKit HAP and Matter protocols simultaneously.
matter._note: Set 'enabled' to true to enable Matter support. Accessories will be available via both HomeKit and Matter protocols. Plugins can use api.publishMatterAccessories() to publish accessories to Matter.

description: This is an example configuration file with one fake accessory and one fake platform. You can use this as a template for creating your own configuration file containing devices you actually own.

ports.comment: This section is used to control the range of ports that separate accessory (like camera or television) should be bind to.
